GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091 (8 Nov 45) GS
(SCAPIN - 252)
8 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Setting Up a Foundational Juridical Person For Aid and Guidance of Demobilized People.
The proposal of the Imperial Japanese Government to set up a foundational juridical person for the aid and guidance of demobilized people, as set forth in its memorandum of 2 November 1945, C. L. O. No. 445 (1), on the subject as above, is disapproved.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
